Intelligent eyewear pre-orders are officially open! ✨

I’m immensely proud and humbled working with teams at @Google, @SamsungMobile, @_GentleMonster_ and @WarbyParker to bring these beautiful eyewear collections to life.

These lightweight glasses bring you hands-free help from @GeminiApp throughout your day. And these glasses are eyewear first, so @WarbyParker and @_GentleMonster_ have brought their iconic styles with a collection of designs, colorways, and sizes so there’s a style that’s perfect for you!

Pre-order your pair today: https://glasses.google and experience them in select Warby Parker, Gentle Monster and Google stores starting today. Shipping Dec 10th!

Read more about the full design collection that and how we are bringing helpful experiences to your everyday life: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/xr-ar/google-intelligent-eyewear-collections-pre-order

Along with our privacy protections for you and those around you:  https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/safety-security/intelligent-eyewear-privacy-protections/

#Gemini #IntelligentEyewear #AndroidXR
